numerical_tolerance.not_applied_to_genuine_infeasibility: R5-HZ1 fails at E*_shock, before any fairness floor, so tolerance cannot and does not mask it

N1_definition: per active crop: farmer with largest expected production fails; ALL their allocations unavailable; target crop recorded
failure_semantics: failed farmer/zone plots FAILED_UNAVAILABLE (incl hard locks = exogenous loss, NOT lock violation); surviving hard locks immutable; failed plots never reused
post_shock_formulation: recompute E*_shock and t_floor_shock; enforce E>=0.95*E*_shock AND capable min-norm>=t_floor_shock (post-shock numerical floor tol 1e-7); same concentration alpha; never extract non-Optimal
validity_scope: surviving-hard-lock, failed-plot-reuse, concentration and hard-constraint checks verified for the 64 Optimal backup plans ONLY (0 changes / 0 reuse / 0 violations there); NOT claimed for the 2 infeasible cases
key_distinction: EXPOSURE REDUCTION (lower alpha lowers immediate single-producer & worst-zone loss) is real; POST-SHOCK RECOVERY CAPABILITY is low and NON-monotonic in alpha — and under strong concentration (alpha<=0.40) one correlated zone outage (R5-HZ1) has NO feasible recovery plan at all (a concentration-vs-recoverability trade-off)
evidence_chain: Phase-4 REVISED PLAN -> simulated shock -> IMMEDIATE POST-SHOCK STATE -> POST-SHOCK REVISED BACKUP PLAN (or documented INFEASIBLE)
interpretation: backup outputs are REVISED/COUNTERFACTUAL recommendations, NOT realised adoption/income; require renewed consent; no second acceptance round ran
scientific_conclusions_changed: Qualitative conclusions UNCHANGED (concentration reduces exposure; recovery low, esp. correlated). NEW finding: strong concentration can render some correlated-outage recovery INFEASIBLE. Corrected hazard immediate-loss denominators; N-1 numbers identical.
